what: Does the input-only selection rule cost us anything on Tier 3? Measured against an oracle.
why_it_matters: On Tier 3 the permitted input is our own reconstruction, not the scoring reference, so a per-clip choice may not read truth. The rule (tools/t3/adopt.py) picks on distance to the reconstruction alone. This is the price of that discipline, now that all 11 fine-tuned clips have been kit-scored against truth as well.

cost_of_refusing_truth.note: The sign on MPPE is the interesting part: the input-only rule is BETTER on MPPE (-10.25 vs -9.85 cm), because the two clips an AUC oracle would add (e18, e20) each worsen MPPE (+0.44 and +11.45 cm) for +0.025 and +0.015 of AUC. Choosing on truth AUC would have traded a board away.

agreement: 8 of 9 gen-1 clips, and 2 of 2 in the second batch: the rule's only disagreement with truth is e18, worth +0.0249 AUC and -0.44 cm MPPE -- a wash.
conclusion: The discipline is free. This is the fourth independent check: the same held on Tier 1, where no clip was ever rejected while a success gate improved. We keep the registered rule and do not read truth to choose.
